data.name: Darakhsha
data.gender_notes: Darakhsha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root ‘drkhs’, meaning to awake or to enlighten. This name signifies a person who is awake to the realities of the spiritual world and is enlightened by the knowledge of Allah. The name Darakhsha carries the meaning “Awakened one, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Darakhsha usually hope their child will grow to embody awakened one, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with wisdom and knowledge, inspiring peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Darakhsha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awakened one, Enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darakhsha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: درخشا

in_hindi.name: दरख्शा

Ultimately, Darakhsha is a reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom, trust in Allah's guidance, and remain steadfast in faith.
